jobs.occupation: Data Engineer DInA
jobs.description:
As our next Data Engineer – Data Insights & Analytics you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups — locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

We seek a skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our Data Insights & Analytics team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, automating, and maintaining robust data pipelines to ensure efficient data collection, storage, transformation, and processing. You will work closely with business analysts, cross-functional teams, and domain experts in the pharmaceutical industry to ensure that the data architecture supports advanced analytics and business intelligence across a range of pharmaceutical projects.

As a Data Engineer, your responsibilities include

• Build, implement, and automate efficient data ingestion pipelines that integrate data from diverse sources, including structured, semi-structured, and unstructured formats, while applying necessary business logic and transformations.

• Develop and maintain data processing solutions using technologies such as Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, SQL, Python, and PySpark.

• Apply data quality practices and frameworks to minimize anomalies and ensure the production of high-quality, reliable data for downstream systems.

• Incorporate error handling, exception management, monitoring, and auditing mechanisms to maintain end-to-end data traceability and support data lineage.

• Design and execute end-to-end tests to ensure the data pipeline and solutions are functioning as expected, covering a variety of data scenarios and ensuring that data flows accurately and reliably from source to target.

• Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data privacy officers, business analysts, and quality assurance teams, to ensure alignment with organizational goals and to facilitate seamless data integration and usage.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience:

• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in a Data Engineer role, with a focus on medium to complex data engineering projects, preferably in the pharmaceutical domain.

• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in cloud data transformation platforms such as Azure Databricks, AWS, or GCP; relevant certifications are a plus.

• Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in Python or equivalent scripting languages is a must.

Technical Expertise:

• Proficient in Structured Query Language (SQL) and experienced in working with relational databases and cloud-based data platforms.

• Experience with Microsoft Azure data services and Databricks, including technologies such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Delta Lake, Python, and PySpark.

• Experience with ETL/ELT processes, data ingestion, transformation, incremental processing, and data quality practices.

• Experience in data modeling and layered data architectures, including Medallion architecture and dimensional modeling concepts.

• Familiarity with RESTful APIs, Git, DevOps practices, and CI/CD processes is a plus.

• Good understanding of Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA data models and data sources across HR and Sales functions.

• Familiarity with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, and Qlik is essential.

Soft-skills:

• Strong consulting mindset with the ability to work independently on defined tasks and collaborate effectively within medium to large-scale project teams.

• Proven ability to work in dynamic, fast-paced project environments without compromising on quality.

• Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE life science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE life science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

jobs.occupation: Senior Commercial Lead – MedTech Startup
jobs.description:
oasicare is looking for an entrepreneurial senior commercial lead to take our women’s health medical device from early clinical adoption to scalable commercial growth.

We are a Danish medtech company developing solutions to improve outcomes in vaginal birth. Our first product, ASISU, is a CE-marked medical device designed to reduce the risk of perineal tears during childbirth. We are already working with leading maternity wards and clinical partners and are now entering the next phase: turning clinical traction into hospital-wide adoption, commercial partnerships, and international growth.

The role

As senior commercial lead, you will own oasicare’s commercial strategy, market development, revenue delivery and commercial organisation.

Your initial mandate is to determine how the existing distributor, direct-to-hospital and consumer-driven opportunities should be combined and sequenced by market. You will then lead execution of the optimal strategy.

You will personally own critical customers, hospitals and distributor relationships, early commercial experiments and major negotiations while building the team and systems required for scale.

Subject to performance, company development and achievement of agreed commercial milestones, the role has the potential to develop into the position of Chief Commercial Officer following a structured evaluation, expected within 9–12 months.

Lead hospital and market adoption

• Build relationships with maternity wards, clinicians, hospital management, procurement teams and relevant professional organisations.

• Convert clinical interest into agreed implementation pathways, trained users, product availability, utilisation and recurring orders.

• Define the role hospitals play in each go-to-market model: customer, clinical adopter, service provider, access partner or demand enabler.

• Personally lead strategically important early accounts and partnerships.

Advance and activate a suitable distributor strategy

• Validate partner fit, commitment, commercial terms, evidence expectations, country access and launch capabilities.

• Negotiate, appoint, onboard and manage distributors in markets where this is the preferred route.

• Establish country plans, training, marketing support, order commitments and performance expectations.

• Measure partner performance through hospital access, activation, sales-through and adoption, not only distributor purchases.

Advance and activate consumer-funded, hospital-enabled model

• Design and test the end-to-end journey from consumer awareness and purchase to hospital acceptance and clinical use.

• Validate willingness to pay, pricing, acquisition cost, conversion, contribution margin, fulfilment and customer support.

• Establish practical onboarding and operating arrangements with participating hospitals and maternity wards.

• Ensure consumer communications, clinical education and promotional claims remain aligned with regulatory requirements and the available evidence.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone with a strong track record in medical devices or medtech commercialisation. Experience with women’s health markets is a plus, but not a requirement.

You should understand that selling a regulated healthcare product is very different from selling conventional products and services.

Ideally, you have:

• Significant commercial experience in medical devices, medtech or a closely related healthcare industry.

• Proven experience selling into hospitals and navigating clinical stakeholders, procurement and complex healthcare decision-making.

• A strong understanding of how regulatory requirements and clinical evidence shape commercialisation.

• Experience taking products from early clinical adoption to commercial sales.

• Experience with distributors and international market expansion.

• Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills.

• Experience in an entrepreneurial, scale-up or early commercial-stage environment.

• An analytical and structured approach to execution

How you work

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive with humility and clinical credibility.

You are comfortable entering a hospital one day, working through a distributor agreement the next, and testing a new commercial assumption the day after.

You listen to clinicians and customers, challenge assumptions with data, and are willing to change direction when the evidence tells you to.

Most importantly, you want to build a commercial organisation around a product that has the potential to meaningfully improve care for women, so you are a natural-born leader others want to follow

Interested?

Please apply through LinkedIn and make sure to attach your CV and a short introduction outlining your relevant experience and motivation.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. The right candidate will have the opportunity to build up equity ownership in the company.

If you have any specific questions regarding the position, write an email to Ditte-Marie Ibsen on ditte-marie@oasi.care.

jobs.occupation: Business Analyst, NewTech - KPMG Advisory Academy 2027
jobs.description:

If you are interested in emerging technologies, steep learning curves, and the opportunity to shape the future of work, this is the place to do it.

About the role

As a consultant in NewTech, you will help deliver AI transformation projects from strategy to implementation and adoption. You will support clients in rethinking how work gets done through AI, combining technology, change management, and business value creation.

Using our NewPractice methodology, you will help organizations build AI-native ways of working, working closely with clients, supporting project delivery, and contributing to proposals and new ideas. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, enjoys learning, and is motivated by ownership and impact.

AI is at the core of how we work. You will actively use AI tools in your daily work, helping us deliver projects smarter, develop new methods faster, and demonstrate effective AI adoption in practice.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

• 
Contribute to AI transformation projects end-to-end: scoping, delivery, and adoption.

• 
Work directly with client teams to design AI-native processes using our NewPractice methodology.

• 
Use AI tools regularly in your own work and helping clients and colleagues do the same.

• 
Translate what our technical teams build into something clients understand and want to use.

• 
Support proposals and helping prioritize use cases based on value, feasibility and impact.

• 
Help develop our methods and delivery approach as we scale.

Perks of joining NewTech

At KPMG NewTech, we work at the intersection of business, technology, and implementation. Unlike traditional consultants, we not only advise clients on transformation but also help design, build, and implement solutions alongside them. Our projects combine AI, automation, emerging technologies, and organizational change, giving you the opportunity to work across business and technical disciplines while turning ideas into practical solutions.

Our team brings together consultants, engineers, data scientists, and software developers who collaborate closely and learn from one another. Working in cross-functional teams, you will develop both advisory and technology-related skills while gaining experience from colleagues with diverse backgrounds.

What sets NewTech apart is our focus on consulting. From day one, you will help shape solutions, test technologies, and work directly with clients to promote adoption and value realization. It is an ideal environment for those who want to work with emerging technologies while staying close to real business challenges.

About you, our new team member

You have good analytical skills and enjoy solving business challenges where technology plays a central role. You are motivated by analyzing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and turning complex problems into actionable solutions. Experience with process mapping, use case development, value assessment, and stakeholder management is an advantage.

You are curious about how AI, automation, and data create business value and are motivated to learn about both the organizational and technical sides of transformation. Most importantly, you are self-motivated, collaborative, and motivated to grow in a fast-evolving field.

More specifically, we are looking for someone who:

• 
Has some background in AI, automation, or digital transformation, whether within strategy, delivery, or change.

• 
Has experience using AI tools in your work or studies, with an interest in developing your AI skills.

• 
Has a structured way of working and the ability to keep projects moving forward.

• 
Is comfortable working in an evolving environment where not everything is defined in advance.

• 
Has a genuine curiosity about AI, its impact on organizations, and emerging trends shaping the business landscape.

• 
Is fluent in English and Danish or another Scandinavian language.

• 
Holds or are expected to complete a relevant master's degree before Autumn 2027.

KPMG Advisory Academy

As part of your development, you will join the KPMG Advisory Academy, a 14-month development program designed to give you a solid foundation for your consulting career. Through a combination of professional training, personal development, networking opportunities, and practical client experience, you will build key consulting skills while expanding your network across KPMG Advisory.

Want to learn more about the KPMG Advisory Academy and how it supports your development from day one? Read more about the Advisory Academy here.

Are you ready to become part of KPMG? Send your application today!

The application deadline is 15 November, but we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process earlier - so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Interviews are expected to take place in November and December.

All we need from you is your CV, transcript, and a cover letter (a one-page document in which you answer the following three questions). jobs.occupation: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
jobs.description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

• 
Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

• 
Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

• 
Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

• 
Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

• 
Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

• 
Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

• 
Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

• 
Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

• 
Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

• 
A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

• 
A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

• 
Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

• 
Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

• 
An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

• 
Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

• 
Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

• 
Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

• 
Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

• 
Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

• 
Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. 

 

Further information 

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

• 
Motivated application.

• 
Curriculum Vitae. 

• 
Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

• 
Complete list of publications.

• 
Publications most relevant to the position.

• 
Summary and documentation of experience in teaching, if relevant to the position. 

• 
A research statement may be included.

• 
References/reference letters may also be included.

• 
A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 10, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is February 2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding.

Employment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. jobs.occupation: Sales Manager, Swedish Market | Copenhagen Area or Southern Sweden
jobs.description:
Are you fluent in Swedish, based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, and ready to help ambitious restaurants grow? Join DinnerBooking and help us expand our presence in Sweden. 

At DinnerBooking, we are building a booking system that brings restaurants and guests together, and we have a lot of fun along the way. With more than 20 million guest bookings annually and 1,400+ restaurants across 11 markets, we help restaurants reach their full business potential. 

We are looking for a proactive and commercially driven Sales Manager based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, for example Malmö or Lund, to grow our customer base in Sweden. You will combine your Swedish language skills and understanding of the market with a structured approach to outbound sales. 

Why join DinnerBooking? 

Besides building a fantastic product, we take pride in our culture. Your ideas matter, your opinions will be heard, and you will be part of a team that supports each other. 

We are problem solvers, colleagues, and friends who want each other to succeed, both professionally and personally. 

Your role 

You will be responsible for identifying and engaging restaurant customers in Sweden. You will join an ambitious international sales team, share ideas and work together to turn opportunities into lasting customer relationships. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

• 
Identifying and contacting potential customers in the Swedish restaurant market. 

• 
Starting conversations through outbound calls, emails, and following up. 

• 
Conducting online meetings and product demonstrations in Swedish. 

• 
Managing the sales process from first contact to signed agreement. 

• 
Maintaining a structured and updated pipeline in our CRM system. 

• 
Working closely with colleagues to ensure a smooth handover and onboarding for new customers. 

What you bring 

• 
You are based in the Copenhagen area or southern Sweden, such as Malmö, Lund, or nearby areas. 

• 
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English, both spoken and written. 

• 
At least 1 to 3 years of outbound sales experience. 

• 
Confidence in opening doors, starting conversations, and building relationships. 

• 
A structured approach to managing your pipeline and following up on opportunities. 

• 
A proactive mindset and the ability to stay motivated and take ownership of your results. 

• 
An empathetic and energetic personality, with a genuine interest in people and their businesses. 

What you can expect from us 

• 
Responsibility for sales in Sweden. 

• 
An international team with strong commercial experience. 

• 
Training in our product, sales approach, and the needs of our restaurant customers. 

• 
The opportunity to make a direct impact on our growth in Sweden. 

• 
A supportive working environment with room for ideas and professional development. 

• 
A compensation package with a component based on performance. 

Interested? 

Send your application and CV in English. We would love to hear about your sales experience, your connection to the Swedish market, and why you would like to join DinnerBooking.
